title: Quorum Mode Governance Rules
description: JSON Schema for governance rules applied to macp.mode.quorum.v1 sessions. See RFC-MACP-0012 Section 4.2.

threshold.description: Override the required_approvals from ApprovalRequest (RFC-MACP-0012 Section 4.2). This is the approval bar and the ONLY gate in schema_version <= 3 — there is no separate participation quorum. Type 'n_of_m' uses a raw approval count; 'percentage' uses an integer percentage (1-100) of the participant count declared at SessionStart, with the effective threshold rounded UP: ceil(value * declared_participant_count / 100). The identifier 'weighted' is RESERVED: it was removed in RFC-MACP-0012 1.2.0-draft without ever having had defined semantics (no weights vocabulary, no electorate rule, no termination arithmetic) and MUST NOT be reused with a different meaning.

value.description: Threshold value: approval count for n_of_m; integer percentage 1-100 for percentage, resolved to an effective approval count of ceil(value * declared_participant_count / 100). MUST be greater than zero (RFC-MACP-0011 Section 5, rule 2; RFC-MACP-0012 Section 4.2).
value.$comment: exclusiveMinimum 0: a zero approval bar is trivially satisfied, so a restrictive-looking quorum policy approves everything. Quorum-side twin of issue #98 item 2, fixed on the Decision side in RFC-MACP-0012 1.1.0-draft.

counts_toward_quorum.description: If true, abstentions count toward the participation quorum but not toward approval.

interpretation.description: How abstentions are interpreted for threshold calculation.

allOf.$comment: Ported verbatim from decision-rules.schema.json, which has enforced this since it was written. `authority: "designated_role"` with no `designated_roles` declares that only designated roles may commit and then names none -- an unsatisfiable authority rule that either bricks the session or fails open depending on the runtime (issue #116). minItems 1 is part of the constraint: an empty array names no one either.
